name: Panal
author: Glenn Overby II (2003) / AGP port
description: Glenn Overby's honeycomb chess on 61 hexes, with the two armies facing each other across opposed SIDES. There is no hex diagonal at all — only the six directions of travel — so the four non-royal pieces are one of each classical move family: the stepping Soldier (two forward directions, not three), the leaping Horseman (any hex exactly two away), the riding Princess and the hopping Gunne, a cannon that may either capture by moving in or stay put and SHOOT. Two royals, two ways to lose: the Princess may be left en prise but her capture ends the game, while the Monarch may not move at all unless he is in check — and then only by swapping places with an unthreatened friend.
